title: Output to Stdout
prompt:
Write a program that takes input from the user and writes it to stdout.
Sample Input: Hello, World!
Sample Output: Hello, World!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a simple Python program that meets your requirements:

```python
# Get user input from stdin
user_input = input("Enter your message: ")

# Write the user input to stdout (print it to the console)
print(user_input)
```

When you run this program, it will prompt the user to enter a message. Once the user enters a message and presses Enter, the program will read the input from stdin (the keyboard) and write it to stdout (the console) as a string. The output will be exactly the same as the sample input you provided.

Here's an example of how you can run the program:

